scope: Binding value arbitration between live widgets and newer model state
negative_control: One edited widget plus an untouched widget produced two model writes instead of one; untouched widget overwrote the newer model value
policy: compare widget values to last accepted binding snapshot
pending changed widget value wins its binding when model also changed
unchanged widget preserves existing model value
missing model paths may still initialize from live widgets
acknowledge snapshots only after successful atomic binding commit, including when subsequent scene rendering fails
implementation: per-Runtime baseline only for text/range widgets
reuse baseline strings/map on acknowledgement rather than recopy all values every sync
no baseline acknowledgement on refused metadata/key/tree transaction
covered: text model update survives unchanged widget
pending edit wins same-field concurrent model value
committed value does not replay over later model update
range model update and keyboard range edits
collection reorder/insertion preserves changed model value of untouched b
render-error correction from model as well as widget across legacy/Svet/backend-switch cases
existing failed-transaction retry and missing-state initialization regressions remain green
limitations: value-snapshot policy rather than historical edit-revision ordering; net edits back to baseline count as unchanged
multiple independent Documents sharing one Runtime binding owner are not qualified
no new full-window/GPU or remote CI qualification
allocation tests cover existing warmed runtime paths, not a zero-allocation claim for Document sync
large-model baseline/state/key-scan cost and peak memory remain open
